info.title: TakasakiInfo API
info.description: Read-only API of the TakasakiInfo database: Love Live! songs, releases, people, characters and concerts in Japanese, romaji and Korean. Every response is `{"data", "meta"}`; names and titles come in every language. `?include=evidence` adds the source and status of every value.

text.description: The spelling as seen in a credit.
text.title: Text

kind.description:
`variant`: another spelling in use; `misprint`: a printing error; `former`: a former name;
`pen_name`: another name the person works under.
kind.title: Kind

names.description: The name in each language, for a pen name or former name that a credit prints (`credited_name`, D58).

kind.description:
What the artist is. `cross_unit`: a unit of members from several projects (AiScReam); `collab`: two artists
singing as one (Saint Aqours Snow); `special`: a one-off ensemble (浦の星交響楽団).
kind.title: Kind

projects.description: Project ids the artist belongs to.
projects.title: Projects

distinct_from.description: Ids of artists with a similar name that are known to be another.
distinct_from.title: Distinct From

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

Audio.description:
Musical attributes of a recording from an outside analysis, with its source in `evidence.audio` (D61).
There is no official value: the label publishes none.

key.description: Key: the tonic, with `m` for a minor key (`F`, `F#m`, `Bb`).
key.title: Key

bpm.description: Tempo in beats per minute, as the source counts it (a half- or double-time reading is possible).
bpm.title: Bpm

time_signature.description: Time signature (`4/4`), only where a source states it (the analysis gives none).
time_signature.title: Time Signature

Audio.title: Audio

birthday.description: `MM-DD`, or `YYYY-MM-DD` for a person whose year is public.

person.description: Person id of the voice actor.
person.title: Person

from.description: First day of the casting; absent: from the start.
from.title: From

until.description: Last day of the casting; absent: to date.
until.title: Until

Character.description:
The family/given split lives in ``family_name`` / ``given_name`` (D26); ``names.ja`` is
written from it by the spacing rule (D28).

project.description: Project id; `external` for a character from outside the series.
project.title: Project

birthday.description: Birthday as the work gives it, `MM-DD` (no in-story year). Its source is `evidence.birthday` (D60).
birthday.title: Birthday

distinct_from.description: Ids of characters with a similar name who are known to be someone else.
distinct_from.title: Distinct From

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

Character.title: Character

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

status.description:
`announced`: schedule only; `performed`: set lists drafted from Fandom; `settled`: set lists cross-checked
and approved; `confirmed`: set lists as on the official Blu-ray or stream. The legacy files list `settled` and
`confirmed` concerts only.
status.title: Status

cast.description:
Cast of every show as the official live page announces it: a voice actor as the character they play, a
stage actor as a person in a role. `featured`: a guest or support appearance (ゲスト出演, 応援出演). A show
with another cast lists its own.
cast.title: Cast

stops.description: Stops of the tour (city, venue, shows).
stops.title: Stops

legacy.description: How the concert appears in the legacy files.

external_ids.description: Ids elsewhere: `fandom` (title of the concert's Love Live! Fandom article).
external_ids.title: External Ids

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover (`title`, `schedule`, `cast`, `setlist.<date>`, …).
evidence.title: Evidence

source.description: Page the notice is printed on.
source.title: Source

checked.description: When the page was last checked.
checked.title: Checked

Credit.description:
One credited person, or a character credited in-story (高咲侑 on Hurray Hurray, D27).
``role`` holds the character a cast member is credited as (e.g. musical cast credited as
lyricists: ``堀内まり菜（椿 ルリカ役）``).

person.description: Person id. Exactly one of `person` and `character` is set.
person.title: Person

character.description: Character id, for a character credited in-story (高咲 侑 on Hurray Hurray).
character.title: Character

affiliation.description: Affiliation printed after the name, `名前(所属)`; a names object when the spelling differs by language.
affiliation.title: Affiliation

fullwidth.description:
The cited official page prints the affiliation in full-width brackets, `名前（所属）`; `ja` keeps them,
`rom` and `ko` are half-width.
fullwidth.title: Fullwidth

role.description: The role a cast member is credited as (`椿 ルリカ役`).

credited_name.description:
The pen name or former name the credit prints, by its alias `text` (`木村 有希` for 園田 健太郎); outputs
show that alias's names instead of the person's current name (D58).
credited_name.title: Credited Name

Credit.title: Credit

editions.description: `all`, or the ids of the editions with this disc, when the editions' track lists differ.
editions.title: Editions

tracks.description: Tracks in order. A track's streaming key is `<disc>-<position in this list>`.
tracks.title: Tracks

label.description: Edition name as printed (`初回生産限定盤`, `通常盤`, `【上原歩夢盤】`).

media.description:
Discs in the package in order, one entry per disc: `CD`, `BD`, `DVD`; `digital` for a digital-only edition
(`[CD, BD, BD]`).
media.title: Media

release_date.description: Release date of this edition, when it differs from the release's.
release_date.title: Release Date

status.description:
How far the value can be trusted. `official`: the rights holder's own; `established`: no official value,
a widely used one whose source a person checked; `derived`: made by a rule and approved; `legacy`: from the
hand-made lists, source not found yet; `draft`: not approved yet (kept out of the legacy files).

source.description: URL the value was checked against.
source.title: Source

checked.description: When the source was last checked.
checked.title: Checked

note.description: Why this source, or what differs from other sources (often in Korean).
note.title: Note

sha.description: Commit the data was built from.

LegacyAlbum.description:
One album in the legacy files. Its Note column is built from parts (M3): ``Disc.N`` when
``flatten_discs``, ``Drama Part`` from the recording kind, ``BGM`` for a soundtrack cue (D53),
``note`` (the whole album), the track's own note, then ``Link is from the [...]`` when the URL is a
main-URL fallback.

title.description: Album name in the legacy files.
title.title: Title

edition.description: Edition id whose tracks the album lists; absent: the discs every edition shares.
edition.title: Edition

note.description: Legacy `Note` for every track of the album.
note.title: Note

flatten_discs.description: Several discs listed as one album, with running track numbers and `Disc.N` in the Note.
flatten_discs.title: Flatten Discs

LegacyAlbum.title: LegacyAlbum

from.description: First day of this lineup; absent: from the start.
from.title: From

until.description: Last day of this lineup; absent: to date.
until.title: Until

from.description: First day as a member; null: from the start.

until.description: Last day as a member; null: still a member.

date.description: Day of the show; null when the release does not say which of the concert's shows.
date.title: Date

label.description: The show's label, when the day had more than one (`Day.2 Evening`).
label.title: Label

dbLastUpdate.description: Time of the data that answered.

count.description: Number of items; for a page, of all pages.

next.description: `cursor` of the next page; null on the last.

Names.description: A name or title in each language.

kana.description:
Reading in kana: song titles (the legacy `pronunciation`) and Japanese names, spaced between family and
given name.
kana.title: Kana

rom.description: Romanization, or the official Latin-script form. People's names are given name first (`Aki Hata`).
rom.title: Rom

ko.description: Korean. A name whose official form is in Latin script keeps that form.
ko.title: Ko

Names.title: Names

recording.description: Recording sung, when the set list links one.

Performer.description:
An artist, a character, or a person. A person singing in a role (musical cast,
``堀内まり菜（椿ルリカ役）``) names the character in ``role`` (D29). A credit that names several
performers as one is not an artist of its own (D48): a guest after ``feat.`` is ``featured``
(``Aqours feat. 初音ミク``), and the performers of a joint name are each ``joint``
(``Aqours・虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会・Liella!``). The builders print the credit from them.

artist.description: Artist id. Exactly one of `artist`, `character` and `person` is set.
artist.title: Artist

character.description: Character id, for a credit that lists characters rather than a group name.
character.title: Character

person.description: Person id: a cast member singing in a role (see `role`) or as themselves.
person.title: Person

role.description: Character id of the role sung; only with `person`.
role.title: Role

featured.description: A guest, printed after `feat.` (`Aqours feat. 初音ミク`).
featured.title: Featured

joint.description:
One of the performers of a joint name, printed joined with `・`
(`Aqours・虹ヶ咲学園スクールアイドル同好会・Liella!`).
joint.title: Joint

Performer.title: Performer

Person.description:
Japanese names keep the family/given split; ``names.ja`` and ``names.kana`` are written
from it by the spacing rule (D28).

names.description: Name. `ja` and `kana` are spaced from `family_name` and `given_name`.

native_script.description: `latin` for a name whose original form is in Latin script; its `ko` is then the original.
native_script.title: Native Script

birthday.description:
Date of birth, `YYYY-MM-DD`; `MM-DD` when the person has not made the year public. Its source is
`evidence.birthday` (D60).
birthday.title: Birthday

aliases.description:
Other spellings seen in credits. Used to match credits; printed only where a credit names one
(`credited_name`: a pen name or former name with its own `names`).
aliases.title: Aliases

distinct_from.description: Ids of people with a similar name who are known to be someone else.
distinct_from.title: Distinct From

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover (`names.ja`, `names.ko`, `name_parts`, …).
evidence.title: Evidence

Person.title: Person

recording.description: The recording the credit is on; null for a work-level credit (lyricist, composer).

first_release.description: Earliest release date of the work.

id.description: Project id (`aqours`, `ikizulive`); `external` holds songs and characters from outside the series.
id.title: Id

legacy.description: How the project appears in the legacy files; absent for a project without files of its own.

copyright.description: Copyright notices of the project, as in the README's Disclaimer.
copyright.title: Copyright

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

category.description: `Category` value of the project in the legacy files.
category.title: Category

file.description: Name of the project's legacy files (`albums/<file>/<file>.csv`, `members/<file>.csv`, …).
file.title: File

id.description: Id within the work (`original`, `off-vocal`, `kanon-ver`). The full recording id is `<work id>#<id>`.
id.title: Id

kind.description: What the recording is. Credits that do not apply (no singer on an off vocal) are empty lists.
kind.title: Kind

title.description: Title as printed, when it differs from the work title.

version.description: Version label as printed (`Off Vocal`, `104期 Ver.`, `高海千歌 Solo Ver.`).
version.title: Version

credits_override.description: Lyricist and composer of this recording when they differ from the work's (rare; the evidence says why).

instrumental_of.description: For an off vocal or instrumental: id of the vocal recording in the same work.
instrumental_of.title: Instrumental Of

live.description: For a live recording (a live CD's track): the show it was recorded at, when the release says which (D54).

duration.description:
Length in seconds, as the label distributes the recording to streaming services; its source is
`evidence.duration` (D61).
duration.title: Duration

audio.description:
Key, tempo and time signature, which the mood labels are made from (D61). An off vocal or instrumental without its
own takes the values of `instrumental_of` in the outputs.

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

version.description: Version label (`Off Vocal`); null for the original.

instrumental_of.description: For an off vocal or instrumental: id of the vocal recording; else null.

live.description: For a live recording: the show it was recorded at (`concert`, `date`, `label`); else null.

main_link.description: Main YouTube Music URL: the earliest released track of the recording that has a video of its own; null when none has.

duration.description: Length in seconds; null when not known (D61).

audio.description: Key and tempo: `key`, `bpm`, `time_signature` as the source gives them, `mood` (labels made from them by rule: `upbeat`, `slow`, `bright`, `wistful`), `from` (the recording they belong to, when an off vocal takes its vocal recording's); null when not known (D61).

representative.description: The recording its work is shown with: the first studio vocal recording, for a soundtrack cue the first instrumental (D61).

RecordingView.description: A recording as a row of `recordings.json`.

Ref.description: A reference with its names in every language.

type.description:
Kind of release. `digital_single`: released only for download and streaming; `bd_bonus`: a CD that comes
with a Blu-ray; `live_album`: recorded at a concert; `box_set`: a box of discs (the earlier releases it
bundles keep their own entries); `radio_cd`: a radio program's CD.
type.title: Type

status.description:
`announced`: not out yet (left out of the legacy files); `released`: out; `verified`: checked again after
release, with no change.
status.title: Status

title.description:
Title. In the entity files, `rom` and `ko` not stored are filled in from the song titles (`A / B`) or from a Latin-script
title.

projects.description: Project ids; more than one for a cross-project release.
projects.title: Projects

artist_credit.description: Artist of the release as a whole, as credited.
artist_credit.title: Artist Credit

release_date.description: Release date. An edition released on another day has its own.
release_date.title: Release Date

editions.description: Editions (初回限定盤, 通常盤, …) with their catalog numbers and media.
editions.title: Editions

streaming.description: YouTube Music albums of the release, one entry per album.
streaming.title: Streaming

links.title: Links

legacy.description: How the release appears in the legacy files.

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover (`tracks`, `editions`, `release_date`, `streaming`, `title`, …).
evidence.title: Evidence

albums.description: The albums the release is listed as in the legacy files; empty: not in them.
albums.title: Albums

matched.description: The name or title that matched.

SearchHit.description: Exact matches first, then those that start with the text, then the rest.

type.description:
A song, or a marker: `mc`, `video`, `encore` (start of the encore), `double_encore`, `talk` (a character
talk), `other` (a game, a sports-day event).
type.title: Type

recording.description: Recording id, when the version sung is a released recording.
recording.title: Recording

version.description: Version sung, when no recording of it is linked (`104th Class Ver.`).
version.title: Version

title_raw.description: Song title as listed, when it is not matched to a work yet.
title_raw.title: Title Raw

version.description: Version sung, when no recording is linked.

title_raw.description: Title as listed, when not matched to a work.

city.description: City id; absent for an online-only show.
city.title: City

performances.description: Shows at this stop, day by day.
performances.title: Performances

editions.description: Ids of the editions this album stands for; empty: every edition.
editions.title: Editions

tracks.description:
Video id of each track on this album, keyed `<disc>-<position>` (`1-1`): `https://youtu.be/<video id>`.
Only the album's own videos: a track missing here falls back to the same recording on another release
(`tracks.json` gives which).
tracks.title: Tracks

no.description: Track number as printed; absent for an unnumbered track.
no.title: No

title_as_printed.description: Title as printed on this release, when it differs from the recording's.

note.description: What is true of this track only (tie-in, act, version label); goes into the legacy `Note`.
note.title: Note

category.description: Legacy `Category` of this track, when it differs from the release's.
category.title: Category

edition.description: Edition id; null for a release without editions.

position.description: Position on the disc, counting unnumbered tracks.

no.description: Track number as printed; null for an unnumbered track.

version.description: Version label of the recording (`Off Vocal`); null for the original.

title.description: Title as on this track, with the reading (`kana`) when known.

link.description: `youtube_music`: URL of the track, or null. `source`: `own` (a video of this release's album), `main` (the same recording on another release), `none`.

note.description: What is true of this track only; null when nothing.

TrackView.description: A track as a row of `tracks.json`.

names.description: Name at the time of the shows.

external_ids.description: Ids elsewhere: `fandom` (title of the venue's Love Live! Fandom article).
external_ids.title: External Ids

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover.
evidence.title: Evidence

kind.description: What the work is. `bgm`: a soundtrack cue played at a concert.
kind.title: Kind

project.description: Project id; `external` for a song from outside the series (a cover, a song of another franchise).
project.title: Project

credits.description: Lyricist and composer. Arrangers and singers are on each recording.

recordings.description:
Recordings of the work. Empty for a song with no recording in the data (performed live only so far, or
released only on a release not in the data, such as a soundtrack or a fan club CD).
recordings.title: Recordings

external_ids.description: Ids elsewhere: `fandom` (title of the Love Live! Fandom article, for matching set lists).
external_ids.title: External Ids

evidence.description: Sources, keyed by the field they cover (`title`, `title.ko`, `credits`, …).
evidence.title: Evidence
